components.note: CPUAdam/HybridAdam host kernel (kernel/x86/cpu_adam.cpp). Built as a CUDAExtension and its header includes cublas_v2.h/cuda_fp16.h; needs the ROCm build path even though it runs on the CPU. Used by Gemini/ZeRO CPU offload.
multi_tensor adam/lamb/sgd/scale/l2norm (apex-derived). l2norm block reduce uses tid<32 and 32-bit shuffle masks.
apex-style fused LayerNorm; launches threads(32,4) and reduces with srcLane & 31 under default-width WARP_SHFL: wrong on wave64. -maxrregcount is nvcc-only.
MoE dispatch/combine/cumsum; cub BlockLoad/BlockStore (hipCUB), 32/64/128-thread blocks.

Inference kernels: kv-cache memcpy, fused rotary, silu, rms layernorm, cos/sin, flash decoding attention, fp8 convert. Inline PTX and __nv_cvt_* fp8 intrinsics in funcs/cast_functor.h; WARP_SIZE 32 with uint32_t(-1) masks in attention_utils.h; bf16 functors gated on __CUDA_ARCH__ >= 800.
Megatron-style softmax; host launcher uses C10_WARP_SIZE as a constexpr, which ROCm torch makes a runtime host value (compile error) -- needs at::cuda::warp_size().
Same pattern as scaled_masked_softmax.

AOT (BUILD_EXT=1) and JIT (torch cpp_extension.load) paths. Rejects ROCm torch (torch.version.cuda is None), requires CUDA_HOME/nvcc, sets TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST from nvcc version, passes nvcc-only flags. BuildExtension rewrites -DCOLOSSAL_WITH_CUDA to -DCOLOSSAL_WITH_HIP on ROCm.
Arm CPU Adam and Ascend NPU flash attention: no CUDA, not a port surface.
fa2 adapter refuses ROCm explicitly (_flash_attention_support); sdpa works on ROCm already; fa3 is Hopper/SM90-only.

fp8 casts, collectives and FP8 linear via torch._scaled_mm; hard-codes float8_e4m3fn/e5m2 (gfx942 needs the fnuz types for _scaled_mm) and gates torch.compile on an SM number from get_device_capability.
Triton inference kernels; num_warps up to 32 (2048 threads on wave64, over the 1024 limit).
get_version returns torch.version.cuda (None on ROCm); `colossalai check -i` reports via CUDA_HOME/nvcc.
